special_component_terms.conditions: Parts only after standard period; requires authorized maintenance records

allowed_fault_types.name: Compressor or Cooling Failure
allowed_fault_types.description: Failure of cooling cycle, gas leakage inside sealed system, or compressor seizure

allowed_fault_types.name: Drive Motor Breakdown
allowed_fault_types.description: Drum rotation failure, motor burnout, or electronic inverter board fault

allowed_fault_types.name: Heating Element Malfunction
allowed_fault_types.description: Defective heating coil in ovens, dishwashers, or water heaters

allowed_fault_types.name: Digital Control Board / PCB Error
allowed_fault_types.description: Error codes E01-E99 indicating internal logic board failure

allowed_fault_types.name: Internal Drainage Pump Failure
allowed_fault_types.description: Internal pump seal failure not caused by foreign object blockage

exclusions.title: Improper Installation or Non-Certified Plumbing/Electrical
exclusions.description: Damage caused by uncertified installation, lack of drainage trap, or incorrect voltage connection

exclusions.title: Commercial or Industrial Usage
exclusions.description: Use of residential appliances in laundromats, restaurants, or commercial facilities

exclusions.title: Normal Wear & Tear of Consumables
exclusions.description: Rubber gaskets, door seals, plastic trays, water filters, carbon brushes, and lint filters

exclusions.title: Foreign Object Blockage
exclusions.description: Coins, pins, bra underwires, or debris clogging pumps, drain hoses, or impellers

exclusions.title: Pest / Rodent Damage
exclusions.description: Chewed electrical wiring, insect nesting in control boards or condenser coils
